system.description:
While falling you strike the air, creating pockets of force that strike like bullets, pelting the ground.

Select a space you can see in range. All creatures in a 20-foot cube originating from this space must make a dexterity saving throw taking your [Unarmed damage] + 6d8 bludgeoning damage and being Staggered on a failed save. The area affected by this jutsu becomes cracked and riddled with fist sized craters and imprints becoming difficult terrain.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d8 and the size of the cube by 5-feet
